extracted.name: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries
extracted.description: Crispy and delicious Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries you'll have ready to eat in just 15 minutes with simple spices and zero deep-frying mess.
ingredient_lines: 1 sweet potato (, peeled and cut into thin 1/4'' slices, see photos above in post)
1 Tablespoon oil ((olive, canola or avocado oil))
instruction_lines: Mix salt, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, and cornstarch in a small bowl.
Place sweet potato slices in a shallow dish and sprinkle seasonings over top. Toss well, covering potatoes in seasoning. Add oil and toss well.
Preheat fryer at 400, once it's hot, cook whole batch for 10 minutes, toss once or twice. Continue cooking as needed until crisp and tender.
